basic_info.description: Built in 1927, with lovely periods details, this elegant Marina-style home is ideally located on a flat block in the West Portal area. The main level boasts a formal entry, spacious living room featuring a pretty fireplace flanked by built-in bookcases, a formal dining room with original wood paneling and a huge eat-in kitchen with an abundance of cabinets and countertop space. A full bath sits directly adjacent to the kitchen.  A second full bath, two generous bedrooms and a sunroom, or light-filled home office overlooking the large backyard, round out this level.  The staircase off the kitchen leads you to an amazing unwarranted living space that can be used as a bedroom or guest suite, with an updated full bathroom. You'll also find a massive garage with laundry and tons of storage space. The full garage can accommodate 1+ car, has its own side entrance, and expansion potential galore. The enormous patio and quiet backyard can be accessed through the garage and are perfect for gatherings.  Perfectly situated within walking distance to all the neighborhood's amenities such as Safeway, Guerra Quality Meats, West Portal Village, multiple Muni lines, easy access to major freeways, the library, schools, parks and restaurants.   A true San Francisco gem not to be missed
